summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of iteration 86: visitor tracking pipeline, admin visits panel, bank accounts accordion, contact page, articles, insurance content, legal affiliation notes, navbar Vize Rehberi dropdown, admin bank editor. 11/11 backend tests pass; all frontend flows verified against public URL.
critical_code_review_comments: Navbar testId helper `nav-link-${to.replace('/', '')}` only strips the first slash, producing IDs like `nav-link-dubai-vizesi/aile`. Works with attribute selectors but the '/' in a data-testid is unusual and can trip up CSS selectors expecting `-` separators. Consider `to.replaceAll('/', '-')`.

Review request referenced legal routes `/sartlar` and `/gizlilik`; the actual React routes are `/hizmet-sozlesmesi` and `/gizlilik-politikasi`. Both correct routes render `legal-affiliation-note` with bold company names. Only a spec/wording mismatch — no code change needed unless E1 wants to add aliases.

`BankTransferIn` still requires legacy fields `account_name`, `bank_name`, `iban` (min_length=10). The new admin bank editor sends the multi-bank `banks` array, but if a user empties the top-level legacy fields the PUT returns 422. Consider making them optional now that per-bank accounts are the source of truth.
test_credentials: admin JWT via `python /app/backend/admin_test_token.py` (email info@dubaivizeonline.com). Frontend localStorage key: dv_admin_token.
seed_data_creation: None. Test only POSTs a tracking visit which naturally creates one row in `visits` (harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints verified: POST /api/track/visit (browser=ok, bot=skipped), GET /api/admin/visits (auth-gated, returns items+total with ip/city/country/isp/created_at), GET /api/admin/visits/summary (fields total/unique_visitors/total_today/bots/daily/countries/cities/pages), GET/PUT /api/admin/bank-transfer (banks[] preserved, requires legacy account_name+bank_name+iban in PUT), /api/content/site.bank_transfer.banks has isbank/garanti/ziraat each with TRY+USD accounts (key is `accounts`, not `ibans`), /api/content/legal.affiliation contains **bold** markers. Frontend confirmed: /vize-tipleri bank cards (isbank expanded default, toggle+copy work, logos load), /iletisim form+map+Ofis:146+phone, /gelismeler 5 article cards (covers load), /seyahat-sigortasi exclusions block+no purchase button, /iade-kosullari, /hizmet-sozlesmesi, /gizlilik-politikasi, /ticari-ileti-onami and /kvkk all render affiliation note with <strong>, footer-affiliation visible on /, navbar-more-menu-trigger opens dropdown with 7 guide links (data-testid `nav-link-dubai-vizesi/<slug>` — uses '/' inside testid), admin /admin/ziyaretciler shows all 4 stat cards + 3 top lists + visitors-table (15 rows in DB, browser visits recorded with ip/city/country), sidebar has Ziyaretçiler entry, /admin/banka shows admin-bank-block-0..2 with save-bank-transfer-button. IP geo resolution working via ipwho.is (Istanbul/Türkiye + Groningen/Netherlands seen). No console/page errors captured on any tested page.
rca of the issue: N/A — no critical bugs found. Initial 2 backend test failures were test-code errors (wrong field names: `ibans` vs `accounts`, missing required `account_name` in PUT payload) and were fixed in the test file, not in product code.
